nodes.Name: TestMerge_NewEntityAdded
nodes.DocComment:
TestMerge_NewEntityAdded verifies that a brand-new entity in the new IR
is appended to the result.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_ExistingEntityFieldsUpserted
nodes.DocComment:
TestMerge_ExistingEntityFieldsUpserted verifies field-level upsert:
old fields are preserved, new fields are added, changed types win.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_NonDestructive_FieldNotInNewIRIsKept
nodes.DocComment:
TestMerge_NonDestructive_FieldNotInNewIRIsKept is the "Safe Evolution" guarantee:
if a field doesn't appear in the new IR, it must NOT be deleted.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_RelationDedup
nodes.DocComment: TestMerge_RelationDedup verifies that duplicate relations are not added twice.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_NewRelationAdded
nodes.DocComment: TestMerge_NewRelationAdded verifies that a genuinely new relation is appended.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_EmptyOld
nodes.DocComment: TestMerge_EmptyOld verifies merge from a blank slate.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_EmptyNew
nodes.DocComment: TestMerge_EmptyNew verifies that a merge with an empty new IR is a no-op.

nodes.Name: TestMergeWithDiff_RemoveField
nodes.DocComment:
TestMergeWithDiff_RemoveField verifies that an explicitly signaled
field deletion is applied.

nodes.Name: TestMergeWithDiff_RemoveEntity
nodes.DocComment:
TestMergeWithDiff_RemoveEntity verifies that an explicitly signaled
entity deletion is applied.

nodes.Name: TestMergeWithDiff_EmptyIntent_BehavesLikeMerge
nodes.DocComment:
TestMergeWithDiff_EmptyIntent_BehavesLikeMerge verifies that an empty
DiffIntent doesn't change the additive-merge behaviour.

nodes.Name: TestMerge_Idempotent
nodes.DocComment:
TestMerge_Idempotent verifies that merging a schema with itself twice
doesn't produce duplicate entities or fields.
